cause_quote: The new startup path cleared the marker with `resumeAfterRestart: undefined`, enqueued one `source: "restart"` event, and handled rejected acceptance with `if (!accepted.ok) { throw new Error(accepted.error); }`.
user_saw: After a Gateway restart, users saw a restart failure and had to send another message if their agent’s dedicated workspace node was still reconnecting.
summary: The fix retries eligible restart inputs once per second for up to 60 seconds when the Gateway confirms the workspace command was never dispatched because the node was disconnected.
reasoning: The introducing diff sent the startup resume input through a handoff whose only retry condition was a configuration change, so a transient workspace disconnect could end the new resume flow on its first attempt. I checked the parent’s recovery code and found retry machinery in the older paths, but could not verify that it successfully resumed the same interrupted turn when a dedicated workspace node was still disconnected.
